label.purpose: Form labels and concise button text.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Copper action for saving or starting the main task.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { display: inline-flex; min-height: 40px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--accent); color: #21170f; font: 600 14px/1.25 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: #dba16f; } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #dba16f; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Warm raised control for secondary actions.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { display: inline-flex; min-height: 40px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--surface-raised); color: var(--foreground); font: 500 14px/1.25 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { background: #35332b; } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #dba16f; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Dark, full-width field with a copper focus border.
components.html: <label class="ds-field-label" for="ds-name">Agent name</label><input class="ds-field-control" id="ds-name" placeholder="Agent name">
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 6px; color: #c9c1b2; font: 500 14px/1.25 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-field-control { display: block; width: 100%; padding: 10px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--background); color: var(--foreground); font: 400 14px/1.5 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; transition: border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-field-control::placeholder { color: #938b7d; } .ds-field-control:focus-visible { border-color: var(--accent); outline: 2px solid #dba16f; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Active Navigation Link
components.description: Selected workspace destination in the persistent desktop rail or mobile row.
components.html: Overview
components.css: .ds-navigation { display: flex; gap: 6px; } .ds-navigation-active { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 10px 14px; border: 1px solid #35332b; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--surface); color: #ebc19b; font: 500 14px/1.25 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-navigation-active:hover { background: #35332b; } .ds-navigation-active:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #dba16f; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Surface
components.description: Subtle tonal panel for grouped state or list content.
components.css: .ds-surface { padding: 16px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--surface); color: var(--foreground); }

narrative.overview: A calm, local operator console for configuring bilingual voice agents and testing saved configurations. Warm ink, limestone text, oxidized copper actions, and moss for confirmed active or successful state keep the workspace grounded. The layout favors clear task hierarchy, grouped settings, and truthful saved state over decoration.
keyCharacteristics: Warm solid surfaces and restrained copper actions.
Grouped settings and list rows with clear save and selection actions.
Native controls, visible keyboard focus, and responsive navigation.
dos: Use actual saved configuration only; do not add placeholder latency, memory, readiness, or benchmark values.
Use associated labels, semantic headings and fieldsets, native controls, and visible keyboard focus.
donts: Do not introduce remote fonts, assets, runtime services, or external runtime calls.
Do not imply a profile is live merely because it is selected.
